name: shoot-1706
about: 1706 preloaded with 8 in its ALLIANCE ZONE in TELEOP: both turrets turn to their own shots (the twin-turret model), each one's accelerators' velocity loop and hood come to it, and each side's spindexer and kicker feed once that turret's on target; the FUEL go into the HUB; then it drives out past the zone line, intakes, and passes back (M3c).
